correctness.rationale: The reciprocal second difference is exactly 2ah^2/[x(x+h)(x+2h)] for unit inputs; hence three-point affineness is N|2h^2. Prime-power valuations and the unit requirement at p=2,k=1 give precisely h in the ideal M R. These h are multiples of every prime dividing N, so all x+jh remain units and all subsequent second differences vanish, giving indefinite extension and an orbit of size ord(h). CRT makes the additive step ideal cyclic of order Q, and counting its phi(d) elements of order d for each unit initial x gives the exact cycle counts. The formula for distinct triples subtracts order 1 and 2 steps; includes N=2,Q=1 and even moduli. Independent brute computation for all 2<=N<=90 checks allowed steps, all rooted cycle counts and divisor spectrum, but does not prove infinite N.
